Measured straight from the root. Waves and curls look shorter once styled. Exact placement varies with your height.

Cap size guide

Measure around your head from the front hairline, over the ears and the nape, and back to the front.

✦ Questions

Good to know

How are bundles priced?

By length and texture, from KSh 3,000 to KSh 30,000. Pick a length on the bundle card to see the exact price.

How do imported hair pre-orders work?

Pick a style and length, then pay a 70% deposit. Your hair is imported for you and is ready in about 14 days. You pay the balance when it arrives, and we deliver it.

\n
How do I order?

Add items to your cart and check out, or message us on WhatsApp and we will take your order.

What comes with my wig?

A free luxury bundle: satin storage bag, luxury comb, edge brush and melt band. Delivery is free within Kenya.

Do you ship worldwide?

Yes. Delivery is free within Kenya. For other countries we use courier services, and we confirm the cost with you on WhatsApp before you pay.

How does a custom wig work?

Choose your length, texture, lace, density and colour. Pay a 50% deposit, approve photos of your wig, then pay the balance before delivery.

Can you revamp my old wig?

Yes. Book a revamp, then drop the wig off or post it to us.

What do the wig classes cover?

Wig construction, ventilating and plucking, bleaching and tinting knots, customizing and fitting, styling, and business tips. You get a certificate on completion.
